input:
Earlier scenes:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

This scene:
他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。比方说，灵芝和夹竹桃。他一吃各种各样的植物就知道能不能吃这些植物。然后，神农写他的主意。他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 然后，神农写他的主意：写下，他的发现

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 旅行很远找到很多植物：走了很远，找到了很多植物，Use “走了很远” to express travelling a long distance; both actions are completed here, so they take 了.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 写他的主意：把自己的想法写了下来，“写” alone does not naturally mean recording an idea; “写下来” means to put an idea into writing, and 了 marks the completed action.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个黄色的花：一朵黄色的花，Flowers use the measure word “朵,” not the general measure word “个.”

items.reason: “旅行很远” is not a natural way to express travelling a long distance, and the completed sequence needs perfective marking.
“写他的主意” does not clearly mean recording his ideas or discoveries, while “把自己的想法写了下来” is grammatical and appropriate.
Flowers normally take the measure word “朵,” so “一朵黄色的花” is correct.
